technicalNotes:
The Longitudinal Acceleration Sensör Okuma Değerleri - G251, is only installed for vehicles that have at least one of the following options:
1X1: Four-wheel drive
UG1: Hill start assist
UG4: Hill hold
7X5: Park assist
7X6: Park Assist with rear camera
8T3: Distance control (ADC)
7L6: Start-Stop system
